page_title: FUL 1-3 LIV | Fulham v Liverpool 21/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Adama Traore (Fulham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
90+5' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
90+4' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Darwin Nunez.
90+2' 11:13 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) runs into space on the edge of the box and tries a curler that drifts well wide of the left post.
89' A rebound spins to Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is coming onto the pitch as Cody Gakpo cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Alex Iwobi will be replaced by Adama Traore (Fulham).

83' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
80' We are about to witness a subsitution. Joe Gomez (Liverpool) for Trent Alexander-Arnold.
79' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) attempts to discuss the decision with Craig Pawson, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
79' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
75' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is adjudged offside.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) replaces Luis Diaz.
74' Jurgen Klopp has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) replacing Diogo Jota.
74' Today's match ends for Ryan Gravenberch who will be replaced by Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool).
74' Referee Craig Pawson points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Liverpool players celebrate.
73' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Liverpool players aren’t happy.
72' 1 - 3 Goal! Diogo Jota (Liverpool) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Cody Gakpo inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:3.
71' Marco Silva has decided to substitute Joao Palhinha and he is replaced by Tom Cairney (Fulham).
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Harry Wilson (Fulham) comes onto the pitch so that Bobby De Cordova-Reid can be given a rest.
68' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) tested Bernd Leno with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
67' A dangerous looking corner kick from Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is cleared to safety by the defence.
66' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. Now Liverpool have a corner.
63' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Bernd Leno easily deals with the threat.
62' The game is interrupted. Diogo Jota (Liverpool) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
61' Craig Pawson blows his whistle. Sasa Lukic (Fulham) commits a foul after dangerous play.
60' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Bernd Leno anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
59' The percentage of ball possession is – 33:67.
57' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
53' 1 - 2 Fabulous goal. Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) collects an exquisite pass and subsequently produces a snap shot from edge of the box which flies into the back of the net off the right post.
52' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

51' A precise low pass is received by Harvey Elliott (Liverpool), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
49' Liverpool are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
47' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) serves up a nice cross, but Bernd Leno punches the ball away.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+2' 1 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Timothy Castagne (Fulham) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Alisson. 1:1.
45+1' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just over the crossbar. It could have been a fantastic goal!
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

45' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) commits a rough challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for an infringement. Fulham win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

45' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
43' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
43' A cross from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

41' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Alisson guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
39' Tosin Adarabioyo (Fulham) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Craig Pawson lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
37' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but it ends somewhere in row Z. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
35' The game is interrupted now, Jarell Quansah (Liverpool) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
35' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
34' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

34' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the top left corner. Bernd Leno has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
32' 0 - 1 Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes a wonderful free kick and curls the ball into the top left corner with an absolutely phenomenal strike!
30' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) takes out his opponent with a nasty challenge and is relieved when the referee only gives him a booking.
28' A poor mid-range free-kick by Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) is easily blocked by the defensive wall.
27' Rough tackle by Joao Palhinha (Fulham). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Liverpool in a dangerous position.
26' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) sends a long ball in, but Bernd Leno comfortably gathers the ball.
24' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Alisson, who makes a comfortable save.
23' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but Alisson comes off his line to gather the ball.

22' Luis Diaz sprays a pass out to Diogo Jota (Liverpool), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
21' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) receives a precise pass outside the penalty area and strikes the ball goalwards. His attempt only finds one of his teammates, though, and ricochets away off him.
21' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
19' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
18' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
16' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
13' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Andreas Pereira (Fulham), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.

12' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) clutches his head after wasting a good opportunity. He expertly collected the ball from a rebound and fired from long range, but his effort wasn't accurate at all and the ball went miles over the crossbar.
12' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

12' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Fulham are going to take it.
12' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) sends a long cross over to Luis Diaz, but Bernd Leno comes forward to gather the ball.
9' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.

9' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
8' The resulting corner from Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

8' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
7' Liverpool enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
3' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) pings a header narrowly wide of the left post from around the penalty spot following a decent cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
3' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes the corner with a short pass.

3' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play and Liverpool manage to earn a corner.
2' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
1' The first half has just begun.
Liverpool will kick the game off.
Craig Pawson will referee today's match.
